records.title: Vacancies in Pollution Control Boards
details:
The Central Government has reminded State Government/UT Administration to fill the
vacancies, at the earliest. In Writ Petition(s)(Civil) No(s).13029/1985 M.C. Mehta Versus
Union of India & Ors, the Hon’ble Supreme Court vide its order dated 8-5-2025 directed all
the State Pollution Control Boards and Committees to ensure that all the vacancies are filled
by the end of September, 2025.

records.title: Elevated Expressway in Tamil Nadu.
details: a to c): As far as the decongestion of the stretch between Tambaram and Chengalpattu of NH-32 is concerned, the work for preparing the Detailed Project Report (DPR), for the development of the stretch from Chennai and Trichy is awarded including the option to explore the possibility for construction of elevated road in the said stretch. Decision will be taken based on outcome of DPR.
